Name: Jas New Portraits and Sprites
Author: Hxoni
Description:
Hi everyone, this time I'm back with new art for Jas. 

[b]What's New:[/b]

- Added new seasonal outfits for all the different options.

- Added a new skin color.

- Updated the code format.

- Fixed minor errors in the assets.

[b]Customization:[/b]

You need to have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/url] if you want to change it. If not, the default settings are: Vanilla skin, no glasses and buns.

- You can change her skin color, hair type and glasses.

For the moment, the options are; Vanilla, Lighter and skin, Long hair and hair Buns, With and Without Glasses.

Don't worry if her jumping frames don't have glasses, she takes them off to play!

The idea came from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Misterfog]Misterfog[/url] with their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31641]Highschoolers Jas and Vincent mod[/url]. So that's why you can see the accessory, skin color and age changed for Vanilla Jas.

Seasonal Outfits are based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url].

[b]Future Plans:[/b]

- Festival and Beach Assets (WIP).

- Add Outdoor and Indoor variants!

- Add more ethnic diversity!

- Make one Refined Mod for more Villagers!

I hope you like it. I'll be working on these changes little by little since I do the drawings and coding myself. Please let me know if there are any issues.

Downloads.Description: Fixed (hopefully) all sprites errors + hair redraw.
